description: 국가철도공단 수도권4호선 승강장이격거리 [railways and stations] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 승강장이격거리는 지하철이나 철도역에서 전동차와 승강장(플랫폼) 사이의 안전거리를 의미하며, 승객의 안전과 이동 편의를 위해 규정된 값입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 지하철, 이격거리, 수도권지하철4호선, 노선명, 도시광역철도. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
